name: campusride
description: CampusRide - University Bus Tracking & Seat Reservation Full-Stack Web Application

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('client/dist')) { fs.rmSync('dist', {recursive:true, force:true}); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true}); }"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
